en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Huzayfa Bin Mansour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Necessitated the Hajj upon the people of Al-Jeddah during every year’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Hudhayfah ibn Mansur who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has made al-Hajj obligatory on people of Jaddah every year.”’
